## Outline

- (35m) Prompt engineering
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/12_plot-image-1`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/12_plot-image-1): ask an LLM to interpret a scatter plot
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/13_plot-image-2`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/13_plot-image-2): replace the plot with random noise and improve the prompt
  - System and user prompts, examples, prompt structure, and interpolation
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/14_quiz-game-1`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/14_quiz-game-1): write the system prompt for a quiz game

- (15m) Evals
  - Datasets, solvers, and scorers
  - Evals with vitals in R and Inspect with chatlas in Python
  - Scorer options and the bluffbench example
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/15_evals`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/15_evals): compare three prompts on two plots
